scope: Unconditional architectural correction to instruction parcel PMP checks and precise fetch fault addresses. This is separate from optional timing changes.
behavior: An executable NA4 word admits C.NOP at PC 0x80000002 when both instruction bytes are allowed.
A 32-bit instruction at PC 0x80000002 whose second parcel is denied retains instruction PC 0x80000002 and fault address 0x80000004.
Adjacent independently allowed NA4 words admit the spanning 32-bit instruction.

qualification.real_frontend_permission_reservoir: PASS for aligned and nonaligned captured paths, ASan/UBSan and native FIR lowering
qualification.independent_oracle: 128-bit byte intervals; TOR, NA4, NAPOT, priority, locked/unlocked M mode, region and XLEN boundaries; unchanged four-byte primitive checked alongside each parcel vector
qualification.negative_controls: Two tval mutations and two parcel-oracle mutations rejected
qualification.scala: Production and test compilation passed; eight selected tests passed before a separately reproduced historical preset expectation failure
qualification.preset_expectation_bridge: One pure constructor test compiled and passed against both the published993 and final combined164-field parameter classpaths after adding already-enabled registeredIssueHeadMask and unconditionalMemoryPayloadCapture to its expectation. This is an existing test omission, not PMP behavior.

complete_cpu_precise_trap.model_scope: Combined explicit seven-flag ON model, same completed CPU objects as fixed COPY gate; not PMP-only whole-CPU
complete_cpu_precise_trap.observability: Public valid trap/commit outputs plus machine-handler CSR mailbox; accepted AXI owners drained

qualification.full_cpu_nemu: Two original short physical integer M-mode NEMU cases pass on the combined ON model, with original PC/GPR/memory negative controls; no PMP-only whole-CPU run
qualification.portable_runner: Exact reusable component wrappers/hosts and CPU host/guest sources included; environment-specific runner remains separate

limits: Component dynamic coverage includes real reservoir metadata; two combined-ON guests additionally cover retirement/trap CSRs.
Noncaptured parallel and scalar IntegerCore consumers were compiled and source-audited, without a separate whole-CPU dynamic run.
Original NA4 failures and unsuccessful test attempts remain preserved separately; no original oracle expectation was weakened.
No board, frequency, mapped area, physical timing or hardware-throughput result.
